name: SikaFiber® Force PP-65/RAD65s
tagline: Polyolefin macro-synthetic fibres for reinforced shotcrete and concrete
summary: SikaFiber® Force PP-65/RAD65s is a macro structural synthetic polypropylene fibre. These fibres show very defined ductile behavior characteristics with excellent performance levels in shotcrete.
metaDescription: SikaFiber® Force PP-65/RAD65s is a macro structural synthetic polypropylene fibre. These fibres show very defined ductile behavior characteristics with excellent performance levels in shotcrete.

items.label: CERTIFICATES AND TEST REPORTS
items.text: SikaFiber® Force PP-65/RAD65s complies with ASTM C1116 Type III and EN 14889-2: 2006, Class 2.

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Store in dry conditions, protected from the weather.

items.label: Compatibility
items.text: SikaFiber® Force PP-65/RAD65s macro-synthetic fibres are compatible with all concrete admixtures and performance-enhancing chemicals.

items.label: Dispensing
items.text:
Entire package can be thrown into the mix allowing for easy handling whilst leaving no waste on site.
Allow 3 to 5 minutes at mixing speed for fibers to disperse evenly throughout matrix.
Can be added to the mix at any stage during batching.
